text: Databases help us store and organize information so we can find it quickly. There are two main types: SQL and NoSQL. SQL databases use tables with rows and columns, while NoSQL databases store data in more flexible ways, like documents. To get information from a database, we write queries. Data modeling means planning how the data will be structured before we build the database. Indexes are also important. They work like a book's index, helping the database find data faster without searching every row. Choosing the right type and design makes applications faster and easier to manage.
